porsche-panamera-e-hybrid-s._reason: AutoScout24 listing states 'Kleinwagen', which is wrong. The car (11/2013, 'E-Hybrid S Facelift') is the Panamera S E-Hybrid of the 2013 facelift; the only Panamera body then was the saloon (Limousine). The estate-like Sport Turismo arrived in 2017 as a new body version. Corrected 29.10.2026 (KARAR-DEFTERI).
porsche-panamera-e-hybrid-s._source: Porsche Newsroom 07.03.2017 'World premiere in Geneva: Sport Turismo expands the Panamera model line' ("The Sport Turismo is a new body version of the Porsche Panamera"; "Based on the successful sports saloon"); ecomento.de 19.09.2013 on the auto motor und sport test ("die hybride Reiselimousine")
